Saint-Gobain Appoints New Senior Executive to Drive Growth in French Construction Materials Market

Cie de Saint-Gobain SA has announced the appointment of Philippe Morel as Senior Vice President for its Building Solutions division, effective July 1. The move is part of the company’s ongoing strategy to strengthen its leadership in the French construction materials sector and respond to evolving market demands.

Morel, who brings over two decades of experience in the construction and manufacturing industries, joins Saint-Gobain from his previous role at Groupe Hexabloc, where he oversaw strategic development and operations. In his new position, Morel will lead initiatives focused on innovation, sustainability, and customer engagement across the group’s French operations.

“We are delighted to welcome Philippe to our leadership team,” said Claire Dubois, Chief Executive Officer of Cie de Saint-Gobain SA. “His expertise in operational excellence and market development will be invaluable as we continue to advance our solutions for a rapidly changing construction landscape.”

Industry analysts noted that the appointment comes at a time of heightened focus on sustainable building practices and digital transformation in France’s construction sector. “Saint-Gobain’s decision to bring in a seasoned executive underscores the competitive pressures and opportunities facing suppliers of construction materials,” said Jean-Luc Mercier, construction sector analyst at the French Materials Federation.

The appointment has been well received by the French Building Materials Union, whose spokesperson commented, “We look forward to working closely with Mr. Morel on initiatives that support the industry’s transition toward greener and more efficient construction methods.”

Cie de Saint-Gobain SA is a key player in the French construction materials industry, serving customers across residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects nationwide.
